dedupe_keys.name: building part specific material inventory and embodied carbon datasets for finnish residential buildings

description: These two linked datasets describe what Finnish residential buildings are made of and the carbon emitted to build them. They were produced at Tampere University and Aalto University by Tapio Kaasalainen, Mario Kolkwitz, Satu Huuhka and colleagues; the material inventory is described in a Data in Brief article. The material inventory (version 1.0.5, 21 August 2026) gives material volumes, masses and intensities per square metre for representative buildings of 53 residential cohorts, aggregated for the whole building, each storey, each building part and some subparts. The embodied carbon dataset (version 1.0.2, 31 August 2026) estimates construction emissions for archetypes of blocks of flats and detached houses built in each decade from the 1940s to the 2010s, using present-day coefficients from the Finnish national emissions database CO2data. Access: open download of ODS spreadsheets from Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 for the inventory and 4.0 for the carbon data; free. Caveats: representative archetypes, not surveyed buildings, and historical emissions are recalculated with today's factors. Simulation uses are building stock material flow and circularity models, embodied-carbon scenarios for renovation versus demolition, and debris estimates after disasters. Related records: the material stock maps and the EDCS courtyard energy dataset.
name: Building-part-specific material inventory and embodied carbon datasets for Finnish residential buildings
